title.zh-CN: 左下腹痛、发热伴白细胞持续升高 · 81岁男性
title.en: Left lower abdominal pain, fever and a rising white count · 81-year-old man

summary.zh-CN: 81岁男性，左下腹隐痛伴发热，入院前抗感染治疗后尿路症状好转，腹痛和发热却始终不退，白细胞也降不下来，收入院查找原因。
summary.en: An 81-year-old man whose dull left lower abdominal pain and fever outlasted antimicrobial treatment before admission, while his white count stayed high, is admitted to find out why.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把高龄患者入院前抗感染治疗后仍有的发热、左下腹局限性腹膜刺激征和中性粒细胞升高按可能的复杂性腹腔感染处理：用NEWS2而不是单用qSOFA筛查（SSC 2026），先留培养再静脉覆盖肠道革兰阴性菌和厌氧菌（SIS 2024），并当天做增强CT（IDSA 2024）。
learningOutcomes.en: Manage fever, localised left lower quadrant peritonism and a rising neutrophil count that outlast antimicrobial treatment before admission in an older man as a possible complicated intra-abdominal infection: screen with NEWS2 rather than qSOFA alone (SSC 2026), take cultures before IV cover of enteric Gram-negative and anaerobic bacteria (SIS 2024), and get contrast CT the same day (IDSA 2024).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用结肠镜和小肠造影判断腹部肿块在肠内还是肠外，并选择影像引导下粗针活检（必要时腹腔镜）取得组织，而不是只做细胞学或贸然切除。
learningOutcomes.en: Use colonoscopy and a small-bowel contrast study to place an abdominal mass inside or outside the bowel, and obtain tissue by image-guided core biopsy (or laparoscopy) rather than by cytology alone or an unplanned resection.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把术中冰冻切片当作初步意见，说明为什么在肠系膜根部受累、病变广泛时只取足量组织、不凭冰冻结论做不可逆的切除（PSOGI/EURACAN 2021）。
learningOutcomes.en: Treat an intraoperative frozen section as provisional and explain why, with the mesenteric root involved and disease widespread, the operation should take generous tissue and not an irreversible resection decided on the frozen reading (PSOGI/EURACAN 2021).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按国际间皮瘤兴趣小组2023年更新的标准（两个间皮标志物和两个癌标志物，必要时BAP1或MTAP免疫组化或CDKN2A荧光原位杂交）评价calretinin阳性、CEA阴性的腹膜肿瘤，并采集职业性石棉接触史。
learningOutcomes.en: Judge a calretinin-positive, CEA-negative peritoneal tumour against the International Mesothelioma Interest Group 2023 update — two mesothelial and two carcinoma markers, with BAP1 or MTAP immunostaining (or CDKN2A FISH) where malignancy is in doubt — and take an occupational asbestos history.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把以成熟中性粒细胞为主、超过100×10⁹/L的白细胞增多作为排除性诊断来认定类白血病反应：先按WHO第5版（2022）排除慢性髓性白血病和慢性中性粒细胞白血病（BCR::ABL1、CSF3R）、隐匿感染和药物因素，不做降细胞治疗，也不盲目升级抗菌药（IDSA/SHEA 2016）。
learningOutcomes.en: Accept a leukaemoid reaction behind a mature neutrophilia above 100 × 10⁹/L only by exclusion — chronic myeloid and chronic neutrophilic leukaemia (BCR::ABL1, CSF3R; WHO 5th edition, 2022), occult infection and drugs — without cytoreduction or blind antibiotic escalation (IDSA/SHEA 2016).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用SPIKES向一位81岁的老人说明腹膜间皮瘤的诊断和不确定性，把减瘤手术（PSOGI/EURACAN 2021）、全身治疗和姑息治疗放在他自己的目标下讨论。
learningOutcomes.en: Use SPIKES to tell an 81-year-old man about a diagnosis of peritoneal mesothelioma and its uncertainty, weighing cytoreductive surgery (PSOGI/EURACAN 2021), systemic treatment and palliative care against his own priorities.

notes.zh-CN: 依据一篇已发表的单例临床病例讨论改写。患者事实沿用1.0.0版从报告中提取的内容：年龄、性别，起病3天后首次就诊，外院考虑小肠肿瘤和尿路感染，抗感染治疗后尿路症状减轻而腹痛、发热持续；起初的尿频、尿急、尿痛和怕冷，无寒战、腹泻或便血；入院查体（腹部膨隆，左下腹压痛、反跳痛，无肌紧张，未触及明确包块，左肾区叩痛）；白细胞由28.8×10⁹/L升至33.3×10⁹/L、以成熟中性粒细胞为主；影像、结肠镜、小肠造影、骨髓和两次血培养；探查所见、冰冻与最终病理及免疫组化；未完整切除肿块；后来白细胞113.7×10⁹/L、抗菌治疗无效、原团队考虑类白血病反应；患者离院，远期结局不详。这些事实尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院、日历日期和身份细节已去除，时间以相对时间表示。对话、阶段、决策、处置选项、评分、教学要点和医护人物是教学设计；1.0.0没有记录的内容（生命体征和体温数值、既往史、平时用药、过敏、石棉接触、其他化验、各项影像所见对应的检查方式、探查方式、病理亚型和其余免疫组化、细胞因子与克隆性检查、确诊后的治疗和远期结局）保持未知。保留的不一致：1.0.0中文写“外院”考虑小肠肿瘤和尿路感染，英文只写“最初考虑”；中文写“广泛粟粒结节”“左肾区叩痛”，英文写“广泛结节”“左肾角压痛”；病理写“恶性间皮瘤”，复盘结论写“腹膜间皮瘤”；两次白细胞计数和113.7×10⁹/L的日期、采血地点未说明。
notes.en: Adapted from one published clinicopathological case discussion. The patient facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0: age and sex; a first consultation three days after onset; another hospital's working ideas of a small-bowel tumour and a urinary infection; urinary symptoms that eased with treatment while the pain and fever persisted; the early frequency, urgency, dysuria and chilliness without rigors, diarrhoea or bloody stools; the admission examination (distended abdomen, left lower quadrant tenderness and rebound without guarding, no definite mass, left renal-angle percussion tenderness); white cells rising from 28.8 to 33.3 × 10⁹/L, mainly mature neutrophils; the imaging, colonoscopy, small-bowel study, marrow and two blood cultures; the operative findings, frozen section and final histology with immunostains; incomplete removal of the mass; a later count of 113.7 × 10⁹/L despite antibacterial treatment and the team's view of a leukaemoid reaction; his leaving hospital with the long-term outcome unknown. They have not yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals, calendar dates and identifying details are removed and times are relative. Dialogue, phases, decisions, management options, scoring, teaching points and staff are teaching design; what 1.0.0 does not record (vital signs and temperature readings, past history, regular medicines, allergies, asbestos exposure, other blood tests, which imaging study showed each finding, how the exploration was done, the histological subtype and any further stains, cytokine and clonality studies, treatment after the diagnosis and the long-term outcome) stays unknown. Inconsistencies kept: 1.0.0's Chinese text names “another hospital” (外院) for the small-bowel-tumour and urinary-infection impressions where its English says only “initially considered”; the Chinese records “widespread miliary nodules” and left renal-area percussion tenderness where the English has “widespread nodules” and renal-angle tenderness; the pathology reads “malignant mesothelioma” and the debrief “peritoneal mesothelioma”; the dates and places of the two counts and of the 113.7 × 10⁹/L count are not given.

triageNote.zh-CN: 81岁男性，左下腹痛伴发热入院。入院前经抗感染治疗，尿路症状减轻，但腹痛和发热持续，白细胞升高。
triageNote.en: 81-year-old man admitted with left lower abdominal pain and fever. Before admission his urinary symptoms eased with antimicrobial treatment, but the pain and fever have continued and his white count is raised.

personality.zh-CN: 81岁男性，左下腹痛和发热一直不好，治疗以后也没退，心里不踏实。问什么答什么，话不多；只说自己清楚的事，药名、化验数字记不住就直说，从不猜。
personality.en: An 81-year-old man whose pain and fever did not shift with treatment, and who is uneasy about it. He answers what he is asked in few words, says only what he knows, and admits it when he cannot remember a drug name or a number rather than guessing.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 口语，短句，不用医学术语；说到小便、大便有点不好意思，但会照实说。
speechStyle.en: Plain speech in short sentences, no medical terms; a little shy talking about his waterworks and bowels, but answers honestly.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我左下腹这儿一直隐隐地痛，还发烧，老是不退。
openingLine.en: Doctor, I've had a dull ache low down on the left of my belly, and this fever just won't go away.

concerns.zh-CN: 烧一直不退，是不是得了什么不好的病？
concerns.en: This fever won't go — could it be something bad?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：入院和检查阶段他躺在病床上，话不多，问到才答；手术阶段他在手术室，不能说话；术后他最想知道到底是什么病、接下来怎么办。不提任何检查结果或数字，不说出诊断，不编造既往病史、用药、过敏或工作经历；不知道的事就直说不知道。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: during admission and the work-up he lies in bed, says little and answers what he is asked; during the operation he is in theatre and cannot speak; afterwards he most wants to know what the illness is and what happens next. He never mentions results or numbers, never names a diagnosis, and never invents past illnesses, medicines, allergies or work history; what he does not know he says plainly.

nonVerbalReason.zh-CN: 在手术室麻醉下接受探查
nonVerbalReason.en: under anaesthesia in theatre for the exploration

label.en: Admission: pain and fever not settling

description.zh-CN: 81岁男性，左下腹隐痛伴发热，起病3天后首次就诊。外院曾考虑小肠肿瘤和尿路感染；入院前经抗感染治疗，尿路症状减轻，但腹痛和发热一直不退，现收住本院病房。向他了解病情、给他查体，安排最初的检查和处置。
description.en: An 81-year-old man has dull left lower abdominal pain and fever; he first sought care three days after it began. Another hospital considered a small-bowel tumour and a urinary infection; before admission his urinary symptoms eased with antimicrobial treatment, but the pain and fever never settled, and he is now on the ward here. Take his history, examine him and start the first tests and treatment.

description.zh-CN: 住院期间做了腹盆腔影像、结肠镜、小肠造影、复查血常规、两次血培养和骨髓穿刺（各项检查的具体日期未记录）。看懂这些结果，判断问题出在哪里，并决定怎样明确诊断。
description.en: During the admission he had abdominal and pelvic imaging, a colonoscopy, a small-bowel contrast study, repeat blood counts, two blood cultures and a bone marrow examination (the day of each is not recorded). Read the results, decide where the problem lies and how to establish the diagnosis.

description.zh-CN: 团队随后为他做了手术探查（本病例没有记录做过经皮穿刺活检）。手术进行中，术者打电话把术中所见和冰冻切片结果告诉你，并问你的意见。
description.en: The team went on to a surgical exploration (no needle biopsy is recorded in this case). The operation is under way; the surgeon calls you with the findings and the frozen-section result and asks for your view.

label.en: After the operation: pathology and blood counts

description.zh-CN: 手术已经结束，他回到病房。看手术记录和术后病理报告，复查血常规，再和他谈下一步。
description.en: The operation is over and he is back on the ward. Read the operation note and the final pathology report, review his blood count, and then talk with him about what comes next.

name.zh-CN: 经验性静脉抗菌治疗（覆盖肠道革兰阴性菌和厌氧菌）
name.en: Empirical IV antibiotics covering enteric Gram-negative and anaerobic bacteria

dose.zh-CN: 先核实过敏史，留取培养后开始：例如哌拉西林他唑巴坦——高龄且入院前治疗失败，宜选覆盖较广的方案，怀疑耐药菌时用碳青霉烯类——按标准剂量并根据肾功能和当地耐药情况调整；48–72小时复评。
dose.en: Check the allergy history, then start after cultures: for example piperacillin–tazobactam — his age and the failed treatment before admission favour broad cover, and a carbapenem if resistant organisms are likely — at standard doses adjusted to renal function and local resistance; review at 48–72 hours.

response.zh-CN: 静脉抗菌药已开始使用。本病例没有记录这次住院所用抗菌药的名称和剂量；不模拟其效果。
response.en: IV antibiotics are running. This case does not record the agents or doses used in this admission; it does not simulate their effect.

name.zh-CN: 对乙酰氨基酚退热止痛

dose.zh-CN: 对乙酰氨基酚1 g口服或静脉，两次至少间隔4–6小时，24小时不超过4 g；体重低于50 kg或有肝病危险因素时减量。
dose.en: Paracetamol 1 g by mouth or IV, at least 4–6 hours apart, no more than 4 g in 24 hours; less if he weighs under 50 kg or has liver risk factors.

response.zh-CN: 已给对乙酰氨基酚。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Paracetamol given. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 说明发热、左下腹反跳痛和入院前治疗无效，请外科评估是否需要引流或手术。
dose.en: Explain the fever, the left lower quadrant rebound and the failed treatment before admission, and ask whether drainage or surgery is needed.

response.zh-CN: 外科医生会来看他。本病例没有记录外科最初何时参与；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The surgeons will see him. This case does not record when the surgeons were first involved; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 请血液科会诊并复核血涂片
name.en: Haematology review of the blood film and marrow

dose.zh-CN: 请血液科医生复核外周血涂片和骨髓，评估白细胞升高的原因。
dose.en: Ask a haematologist to review the blood film and the marrow and to assess the cause of the high count.

response.zh-CN: 血液科医生会复核涂片和骨髓。本病例没有记录血液科会诊；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Haematology will review the film and the marrow. This case does not record a haematology consultation; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 影像、病理、外科、肿瘤内科和姑息治疗医生共同讨论诊断和治疗方案。
dose.en: Radiology, pathology, surgery, medical oncology and palliative care review the diagnosis and the plan together.

response.zh-CN: 已提交多学科讨论。本病例没有记录多学科讨论；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Referred to the MDT. This case does not record an MDT discussion; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 抗菌药物复评：找不到感染证据就停药
name.en: Antibiotic review: stop if no infection is found

dose.zh-CN: 复核培养、影像和感染指标，看有无需要处理的感染灶；没有感染证据时停用经验性抗菌药，并记录理由。
dose.en: Review the cultures, imaging and markers of infection for a source that needs treating; if there is no evidence of infection, stop the empirical antibiotics and record why.

response.zh-CN: 已复评抗菌药物。本病例没有记录是否或何时停用抗菌药；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The antibiotics have been reviewed. This case does not record whether or when they were stopped; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 控制发热、腹痛和腹胀等症状，并和他一起制定照护计划。
dose.en: Control his symptoms — fever, pain, abdominal swelling — and make a care plan with him.

response.zh-CN: 姑息治疗团队会来看他。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The palliative care team will see him. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 与他（及他希望在场的家人）谈诊断和下一步
name.en: Meet him, with anyone he wants present, about the diagnosis and plan

dose.zh-CN: 安静的房间，留足时间；先了解他知道多少、想知道多少，再说明诊断、不确定性和可选的治疗，问清他最看重什么，约好下次再谈，并记录。
dose.en: A quiet room and enough time; find out what he knows and wants to know, explain the diagnosis, the uncertainty and the options, ask what matters most to him, agree when to talk again, and document it.

response.zh-CN: 谈话已安排。本病例没有记录告诉了他什么；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The meeting is arranged. This case does not record what he was told; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 地塞米松静脉推注退热
name.en: IV dexamethasone to bring the fever down

dose.zh-CN: 地塞米松5 mg静脉推注。

harm.zh-CN: 糖皮质激素不是退热药：原卫生部《糖皮质激素类药物临床应用指导原则》（2011）把单纯以退热、止痛为目的使用列为不合理用药。感染没有排除时，激素会掩盖并加重感染，本身还会使中性粒细胞升高，干扰对白细胞增多原因的排查；在取得组织诊断之前使用，还可能让淋巴瘤等病变的活检无法确诊。应先查清发热原因、取得组织学诊断。
harm.en: Corticosteroids are not antipyretics: China's 2011 Ministry of Health principles for glucocorticoid use name giving them purely to bring down a fever or relieve pain as misuse. Until infection has been excluded a steroid masks and worsens it, and it raises the neutrophil count itself, muddying the search for the cause of his leucocytosis; before a tissue diagnosis it can also leave a lymphoma or similar lesion undiagnosable on biopsy. Find the cause of the fever and obtain the histology first.

response.zh-CN: 已给地塞米松。本病例没有记录用过激素；不模拟其后果。
response.en: Dexamethasone given. This case does not record any steroid; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 切除病变及相连的肠管
name.en: Resect the lesion with the attached bowel

dose.zh-CN: 整块切除病变，连同与之相连的肠管。
dose.en: En bloc resection of the lesion with the bowel attached to it.

harm.zh-CN: 没有最终组织学诊断就切除，是凭初步意见做不可逆的大手术；如果病变位于肠系膜根部或已在腹腔内广泛播散，切除既不能清除病灶，又会危及肠系膜上血管和大段小肠。PSOGI/EURACAN 2021指南把减瘤手术留给确诊后、经过筛选、在有经验中心治疗的患者。
harm.en: Resecting without a final histological diagnosis is an irreversible major operation on a provisional opinion; if the disease lies at the mesenteric root or has spread through the abdomen, resection cannot clear it and endangers the superior mesenteric vessels and much of the small bowel. PSOGI/EURACAN 2021 keeps cytoreductive surgery for selected patients with a confirmed diagnosis at experienced centres.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录这样的手术；不模拟其后果。
response.en: This case does not record this operation; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.en: Hydroxycarbamide to lower the white count

dose.zh-CN: 羟基脲口服，按白细胞计数调整剂量。
dose.en: Hydroxycarbamide by mouth, the dose adjusted to the white count.

harm.zh-CN: 羟基脲用于骨髓增殖性肿瘤降低细胞数，不用于反应性中性粒细胞增多；在按WHO第5版（2022）证实慢性髓性白血病或慢性中性粒细胞白血病（BCR::ABL1、CSF3R）之前，它只是在降一个数字，还会让一位可能有感染的高龄患者骨髓抑制。白细胞淤滞来自原始细胞，以成熟中性粒细胞为主的白细胞增多不需要降细胞治疗。
harm.en: Hydroxycarbamide lowers counts in myeloproliferative neoplasms, not in a reactive neutrophilia; until chronic myeloid or chronic neutrophilic leukaemia has been shown (BCR::ABL1, CSF3R — WHO 5th edition, 2022) it treats a number, and it risks marrow suppression in an older man who may be infected. Leukostasis comes from blasts; a count of mature neutrophils needs no cytoreduction.

response.zh-CN: 已给羟基脲。本病例没有记录这样处理；不模拟其后果。
response.en: Hydroxycarbamide given. This case does not record it; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 升级为碳青霉烯类并加用抗真菌药
name.en: Escalate to a carbapenem and add an antifungal

dose.zh-CN: 停用原方案，改用碳青霉烯类（如美罗培南），加用静脉抗真菌药，剂量按肾功能调整。
dose.en: Replace the regimen with a carbapenem (such as meropenem) and add an IV antifungal, doses adjusted to renal function.

harm.zh-CN: 没有培养结果或新的感染灶作依据，仅因白细胞高就升级为碳青霉烯类并加用抗真菌药，只会增加毒性、艰难梭菌感染和耐药（IDSA/SHEA 2016抗菌药物管理指南）；社区获得的腹腔感染一般不需要经验性抗真菌治疗（SIS 2024不建议低危患者经验性抗真菌）。抗菌治疗下白细胞仍升高时，应重新寻找未控制的感染灶，并考虑非感染原因。
harm.en: Escalating to a carbapenem and adding an antifungal for a high count, with no culture result or new source to guide it, adds toxicity, C. difficile infection and resistance (IDSA/SHEA 2016 stewardship guideline); community-acquired abdominal infection does not usually need empirical antifungal cover (SIS 2024 advises against it in lower-risk patients). When the count keeps rising on antibiotics, look for an uncontrolled source and consider non-infective causes.

response.zh-CN: 已升级抗菌方案。本病例没有记录这样处理；不模拟其后果。
response.en: The regimen has been escalated. This case does not record it; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 改口服抗菌药出院，门诊随访
name.en: Discharge home on oral antibiotics with clinic follow-up

dose.zh-CN: 出院，口服抗菌药，1–2周后门诊复查血常规。
dose.en: Home on oral antibiotics, with a clinic visit and a repeat blood count in 1–2 weeks.

harm.zh-CN: 81岁、发热、左下腹反跳痛、白细胞升高，入院前治疗后腹痛和发热仍不退，可能存在需要处理的腹腔感染源或其他严重疾病；他需要住院、留培养、静脉抗菌药和影像检查（SIS 2024；IDSA 2024），不能按单纯尿路感染让他回家。
harm.en: An 81-year-old with fever, left lower quadrant rebound and a raised white count, whose pain and fever outlasted treatment before admission, may have an abdominal source that needs control or another serious illness; he needs admission, cultures, IV antibiotics and imaging (SIS 2024; IDSA 2024), not a trip home as a simple urinary infection.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录这样的安排；不模拟其后果。
response.en: This case does not record this plan; it does not simulate the consequences.

title.zh-CN: 听他讲清这次生病的经过
title.en: Hear how his illness has gone

hint.zh-CN: 治疗以后，哪些症状减轻了、哪些没有？哪些线索指向泌尿系统，哪些指向肠道？
hint.en: After the treatment, which symptoms eased and which did not? Which clues point to the urinary tract and which to the bowel?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁，向他了解起病、症状的变化和之前的诊治。
guidance.en: Go to his bedside and ask about the onset, how his symptoms have changed and the care he had before.

title.en: Examine his abdomen and renal angles

hint.zh-CN: 哪些体征能告诉你腹膜受到了刺激？哪些更像来自肾脏？
hint.en: Which signs would tell you the peritoneum is irritated, and which would point to the kidney instead?

guidance.zh-CN: 在床旁给他做腹部视诊、触诊和肾区叩诊。
guidance.en: At the bedside, inspect and palpate his abdomen and percuss his renal angles.

title.zh-CN: 落实最初几小时的处置
title.en: Act in his first hours on the ward

hint.zh-CN: 入院前治疗过，发热和腹痛还在：换药之前必须先留什么？要给什么？哪项检查能看清他腹腔里发生了什么？
hint.en: His fever and pain have outlasted the treatment he had before admission: what must you send before changing anything, what will you give, and which test will show you what is happening in his abdomen?

guidance.zh-CN: 开出最初的检查，在会诊板作答决策1，并在床旁落实你的方案。
guidance.en: Send the first tests, answer decision 1 on the case board and carry out your plan at the bedside.

title.zh-CN: 解读检查结果，规划确诊途径
title.en: Read the work-up and plan the diagnosis

hint.zh-CN: 影像和两项肠道检查说明问题出在哪里？什么样的标本能让病理医生给出明确诊断？
hint.en: Where do the scans and the two bowel studies place the problem, and what sample would let a pathologist name it?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅影像、结肠镜、小肠造影、复查的血常规、血培养和骨髓结果，在会诊板作答决策2，并按你的选择申请取组织。
guidance.en: Read the imaging, colonoscopy, small-bowel study, repeat count, blood cultures and marrow, answer decision 2 on the case board and request the tissue sampling you chose.

title.zh-CN: 第一份组织结果出来时给出建议
title.en: Advise when the first tissue result comes back

hint.zh-CN: 冰冻切片的结论有多可靠？要让病理科最终确诊，手术台上需要留下什么？
hint.en: How far can a frozen section be trusted, and what must the operation leave the pathologists to be sure?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅术中所见和冰冻切片报告，在会诊板作答决策3。
guidance.en: Read the operative findings and the frozen-section report, then answer decision 3 on the case board.

title.zh-CN: 权衡病理与白细胞，与他商定下一步
title.en: Weigh the pathology and the count, and plan with him

hint.zh-CN: 哪份病理结论更有分量？这组染色够不够？除了感染，还有什么能让白细胞升得这么高，又怎样证实？你会怎样开始和他的谈话？
hint.en: Which pathology reading carries more weight, and is this panel enough? Besides infection, what can drive a count this high, and how would you show it? How will you open the conversation with him?

guidance.zh-CN: 术后：调阅手术记录、术后病理和最新血常规，作答决策4和决策5，和他谈诊断与下一步，最后调阅病程与转归记录。
guidance.en: After the operation: read the operation note, the final pathology and the latest count, answer decisions 4 and 5, talk with him about the diagnosis and plan, then read the course-and-outcome record.

prompt.zh-CN: 81岁男性，左下腹隐痛伴发热，起病3天后首次就诊；外院考虑小肠肿瘤和尿路感染，治疗后尿频、尿急、尿痛减轻，但腹痛、发热持续。查体：腹部膨隆，左下腹压痛、反跳痛，无肌紧张，未触及明确包块，左肾区叩痛。白细胞28.8×10⁹/L。入院最初几小时怎么处理？
prompt.en: An 81-year-old man has dull left lower abdominal pain and fever; he first sought care three days after it began. Another hospital considered a small-bowel tumour and a urinary infection; after treatment his frequency, urgency and dysuria eased, but the pain and fever continued. His abdomen is distended and tender in the left lower quadrant with rebound but no guarding; no definite mass is felt, and the left renal angle is tender to percussion. White cells 28.8 × 10⁹/L. What do you do in his first hours?

need.zh-CN: 先问清起病、尿路症状、病情变化和之前的诊治，完成腹部和肾区检查，并看血常规。
need.en: First take the history of the onset, the urinary symptoms, the course and the earlier care, examine his abdomen and renal angles, and read the blood count.

text.zh-CN: 按可能的复杂性腹腔感染处理：先留血、尿培养，再静脉用覆盖肠道革兰阴性菌和厌氧菌的抗菌药，当天做腹盆腔增强CT
text.en: Treat it as a possible complicated abdominal infection: blood and urine cultures first, then IV antibiotics covering enteric Gram-negative and anaerobic bacteria, and contrast CT of the abdomen and pelvis today

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。高龄、发热、左下腹局限性腹膜刺激征（反跳痛）、白细胞28.8×10⁹/L，入院前治疗后腹痛发热仍不退，在证明是别的病之前都应按复杂性腹腔感染处理：美国外科感染学会（SIS）2024年更新的指南要求经验性覆盖肠道革兰阴性杆菌和厌氧菌（以甲硝唑为联合方案中的抗厌氧菌药），并在12小时内（合并脓毒性休克时6小时内）控制感染源。先留培养再换药，选药前核实过敏史（他说不清）；在查过肾功能的前提下做增强CT——美国感染病学会（IDSA）2024年指南建议怀疑憩室炎或腹腔脓肿时首选CT——它能显示病因，并指导引流或手术。拯救脓毒症运动（SSC）2026年指南不建议单用qSOFA筛查，应测全套生命体征、用NEWS2等评分。
feedback.en: Right. An older man with fever, localised peritonism (rebound), white cells of 28.8 × 10⁹/L and pain and fever that outlasted treatment before admission has a complicated intra-abdominal infection until shown otherwise: the Surgical Infection Society's 2024 update asks for empirical cover of enteric Gram-negative bacilli and anaerobes (metronidazole as the anti-anaerobic partner) and source control within 12 hours (6 with septic shock). Take cultures before changing antibiotics and check his allergy status (he cannot say) before choosing the agent; contrast CT, with renal function checked, is the first imaging the IDSA 2024 guideline advises for a suspected diverticulitis or abscess, and it shows the cause and guides drainage or surgery. The Surviving Sepsis Campaign 2026 advises against qSOFA alone for screening — take a full set of observations and score NEWS2.

text.zh-CN: 尿路症状加左肾区叩痛提示急性肾盂肾炎：改用静脉头孢菌素，送尿培养，48小时后复查血常规，仍发热再做影像检查
text.en: His urinary symptoms and left renal-angle tenderness point to acute pyelonephritis: switch to an IV cephalosporin, send a urine culture, repeat the count in 48 hours, and image him only if the fever then persists

feedback.zh-CN: 肾区叩痛和起初的尿路症状确实提示肾盂肾炎，但现在尿路症状已经好转，腹痛发热却没退，而且出现了左下腹反跳痛，单纯肾盂肾炎解释不了。入院前的治疗已经失败，再等48小时才做影像，会延误寻找和控制腹腔感染源（IDSA 2024建议怀疑憩室炎或脓肿时首选CT）。应先留培养、静脉覆盖肠道菌，并当天做增强CT。
feedback.en: Renal-angle tenderness and the early urinary symptoms do suggest pyelonephritis, but those symptoms have eased while the pain and fever have not, and left lower quadrant rebound is not explained by pyelonephritis alone. Treatment before admission has already failed, so another 48 hours before imaging delays finding and controlling an abdominal source (IDSA 2024 makes CT the first imaging for a suspected diverticulitis or abscess). Take cultures, cover enteric organisms IV and get contrast CT today.

text.zh-CN: 外院怀疑肠道肿瘤：先停用抗菌药，以免干扰培养和病理，尽快安排结肠镜找原发灶，等活检结果出来再决定治疗
text.en: The other hospital suspected a bowel tumour: stop the antibiotics so they do not cloud the cultures or the histology, book an early colonoscopy to find the primary, and plan treatment on the biopsy result

feedback.zh-CN: 停用抗菌药会让一位可能有腹腔感染的高龄患者失去治疗；有局限性腹膜刺激征、又还没有做影像排除穿孔或脓肿时做结肠镜，有穿孔风险。世界急诊外科学会（WSES）2020年结肠憩室炎指南以增强CT为首选检查，结肠镜要等急性期过后。先做CT，再决定是否需要内镜。
feedback.en: Stopping antibiotics leaves an older man with a possible abdominal infection untreated, and colonoscopy with localised peritonism, before imaging has excluded a perforation or an abscess, risks perforating the bowel. The World Society of Emergency Surgery 2020 diverticulitis guideline makes contrast CT the first test and leaves colonoscopy until the acute episode has settled. CT first; endoscopy only if it is still needed.

text.zh-CN: 抗感染治疗已经无效，多半是肿瘤热：停用抗菌药，用地塞米松把体温降下来，再择期安排腹部影像检查，看清肿瘤在哪里
text.en: Antimicrobials have already failed, so this is probably tumour fever: stop the antibiotics, give dexamethasone to bring his temperature down, and arrange elective abdominal imaging to locate the tumour

feedback.zh-CN: “肿瘤热”只能在排除感染以后考虑，而他还有局限性腹膜刺激征和升高的白细胞。地塞米松不能当退热药用（原卫生部《糖皮质激素类药物临床应用指导原则》2011：单纯以退热为目的使用属于不合理用药），它会掩盖并加重腹腔感染；在取得组织之前用激素，还可能让淋巴瘤等病变的活检无法确诊。应先留培养、静脉抗感染并尽快做CT。
feedback.en: Tumour fever is considered only once infection has been excluded, and he still has localised peritonism and a raised white count. Dexamethasone is no antipyretic (China's 2011 Ministry of Health principles for glucocorticoid use name using steroids purely to bring down a fever as misuse); it can mask and worsen an abdominal infection, and steroids before tissue is taken can leave a lymphoma or similar lesion undiagnosable on biopsy. Cultures, IV antibiotics and prompt CT come first.

prompt.zh-CN: 影像：左下腹囊实性混合肿块，约7.1 cm×6.3 cm×9.9 cm，周围脂肪模糊，腹盆腔积液，超声显示有血流。结肠镜未见明显异常；小肠造影见肠管受外压、无造影剂外漏，支持肠外占位。下一步怎样明确诊断？
prompt.en: Imaging: a mixed cystic and solid mass in the left lower abdomen, about 7.1 × 6.3 × 9.9 cm, with blurred surrounding fat and fluid in the abdomen and pelvis; ultrasound shows vascularity. Colonoscopy: no obvious abnormality. Small-bowel study: extrinsic compression without leak, in keeping with a mass outside the bowel. How will you establish the diagnosis?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅影像报告、结肠镜和小肠造影结果。
need.en: First read the imaging report, the colonoscopy and the small-bowel study.

text.zh-CN: 肿块在肠外（系膜或腹膜）：影像引导下对实性部分做粗针穿刺活检，同时抽腹水送常规、培养和细胞学，带着结果提交多学科讨论
text.en: The mass lies outside the bowel, in the mesentery or peritoneum: take an image-guided core biopsy of its solid part, tap the ascites for cell count, culture and cytology, and take the results to the MDT

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。结肠镜无明显异常、小肠受外压而无外漏，说明肿块在肠外；有血流的实性成分不像单纯脓肿。鉴别包括淋巴瘤、胃肠间质瘤、肉瘤、腹膜原发肿瘤和转移瘤，治疗完全取决于组织学和免疫组化，粗针活检能给病理医生足够的组织（穿刺前先查血小板和凝血，本病例没有记录）；腹水检查能同时查感染和肿瘤细胞。腹膜表面肿瘤协作组（PSOGI/EURACAN）2021年指南同样要求以粗针穿刺活检或探查性腹腔镜取得的组织诊断，而不是积液细胞学或细针穿刺材料；没有安全的经皮穿刺路径时再取腹腔镜活检。
feedback.en: Right. A colonoscopy without obvious abnormality and extrinsic compression without leak place the mass outside the bowel, and a vascular solid component is unlike a simple abscess. The differential — lymphoma, GIST, sarcoma, a primary peritoneal tumour, metastasis — is decided only by histology with immunostaining, and a core biopsy, once platelets and clotting are checked (not recorded here), gives the pathologist enough tissue; the ascitic tap tests for infection and tumour cells at the same time. The peritoneal surface oncology guideline (PSOGI/EURACAN 2021) likewise requires tissue from a core needle biopsy or exploratory laparoscopy, not effusion cytology or fine-needle material; laparoscopy is the route when there is no safe percutaneous window.

text.zh-CN: 肿块大、症状重，直接手术探查：术中用冰冻切片决定切除范围，争取一次手术既明确诊断又切除肿块，也免去经皮穿刺带来的风险
text.en: The mass is large and he is unwell, so explore him surgically: let a frozen section set the extent of resection, aiming to diagnose and remove it in one operation and spare him a needle biopsy

feedback.zh-CN: 原报告的团队确实选择了手术探查。但在不知道肿块性质时就手术探查，冰冻切片只能给出初步意见，切除范围可能定错；若病变不能切除，就等于为取组织做了一次大手术。对一位发热的81岁老人，现行做法是先用创伤小的方式取得组织学诊断并经多学科讨论（PSOGI/EURACAN 2021），手术留给诊断明确、可以从中获益的情况。
feedback.en: The report's team did choose a surgical exploration. But operating without knowing what the mass is leaves the extent of surgery to a provisional frozen section, and if it proves unresectable he has had a major operation just for tissue. For a febrile 81-year-old, current practice is a histological diagnosis by the least invasive route and an MDT plan first (PSOGI/EURACAN 2021), keeping surgery for when the diagnosis is known and he can benefit.

text.zh-CN: 超声引导下细针穿刺做细胞学就够了：创伤最小、出血风险低，只要找到恶性细胞，就按细胞学提示的肿瘤类型开始治疗
text.en: Ultrasound-guided fine-needle aspiration for cytology is enough: it is the least invasive and least likely to bleed, and once malignant cells are found you can treat the tumour type the cytology suggests

feedback.zh-CN: 细针穿刺的细胞学常常不足以给淋巴瘤分型、区分间叶性肿瘤或腹膜原发与转移性肿瘤，也做不了成套免疫组化；结果不确定时还得再穿一次。粗针活检保留组织结构，是腹腔肿块取材的首选（PSOGI/EURACAN 2021以足量活检的组织学为诊断依据）。
feedback.en: Fine-needle cytology often cannot subtype a lymphoma, separate mesenchymal tumours or tell a primary peritoneal tumour from a metastasis, and leaves too little for a full immunohistochemical panel, so an indeterminate result means another needle. A core biopsy keeps the tissue architecture and is the usual first sample of an abdominal mass (PSOGI/EURACAN 2021 bases diagnosis on histology from adequate biopsies).

text.zh-CN: 按炎性包块或脓肿处理：再静脉用两周抗菌药，复查影像看肿块有没有缩小，不缩小再考虑活检，这样可以避免一次不必要的穿刺
text.en: Treat it as an inflammatory mass or abscess: two more weeks of IV antibiotics, then re-image to see whether it has shrunk, and biopsy only if it has not, sparing him a needle he may not need

feedback.zh-CN: 有血流的囊实性肿块、无明显异常的结肠镜和无外漏的小肠造影，都不支持单纯的脓肿或憩室炎性包块；他的白细胞还在上升。再等两周会延误诊断，而盲目延长抗菌疗程不符合抗菌药物管理原则（IDSA/SHEA 2016）。应先取得组织，同时抽腹水查感染。
feedback.en: A vascular cystic-solid mass, a colonoscopy without obvious abnormality and a small-bowel study without leak do not support a simple abscess or diverticular phlegmon, and his count is still rising. Two more weeks delays the diagnosis, and stretching an empirical course without a target runs against antibiotic stewardship (IDSA/SHEA 2016). Get tissue now, and tap the fluid for infection at the same time.

prompt.zh-CN: 术中见肠系膜根部肿块，伴广泛粟粒结节；冰冻切片考虑转移性腺癌。术者问你的意见：现在怎么做？
prompt.en: At operation there is a mass at the root of the mesentery with widespread miliary nodules; the frozen section suggests metastatic adenocarcinoma. The surgeon asks for your view: what now?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅术中所见和冰冻切片报告。
need.en: First read the operative findings and the frozen-section report.

text.zh-CN: 多处取足量组织做石蜡切片和免疫组化，留新鲜组织送培养（包括结核），记录病变范围，不做切除，关腹后等最终病理和多学科讨论
text.en: Take generous biopsies from several sites for paraffin histology and immunostaining, send fresh tissue for culture including TB, record the extent of disease and close without resecting until the final report and MDT

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。冰冻切片只是初步意见，间皮瘤等腹膜原发肿瘤和转移性腺癌在冰冻上容易混淆，确诊要靠石蜡切片和成套免疫组化（国际间皮瘤兴趣小组IMIG 2023年更新的病理诊断指南）。肠系膜根部受累、病变广泛时，切除既不能清除病灶，又会危及肠系膜上血管；PSOGI/EURACAN 2021指南把减瘤手术留给确诊后、经过筛选、在有经验中心治疗的患者。伴发热的粟粒结节还要排除结核，所以要留新鲜组织送培养。
feedback.en: Right. A frozen section is a provisional reading — mesothelioma and other primary peritoneal tumours are easily mistaken for metastatic adenocarcinoma on frozen tissue — and the diagnosis rests on paraffin histology with a full immunohistochemical panel (International Mesothelioma Interest Group 2023 update). With the mesenteric root involved and disease widespread, resection cannot clear it and endangers the superior mesenteric vessels; PSOGI/EURACAN 2021 keeps cytoreductive surgery for selected patients with a confirmed diagnosis at experienced centres. Miliary nodules with fever also mean TB must be excluded, hence fresh tissue for culture.

text.zh-CN: 冰冻已经提示转移性腺癌：趁这次手术切除肿块及受累的肠管和系膜，减轻肿瘤负荷，缓解症状，也为术后化疗创造条件
text.en: The frozen section already shows metastatic adenocarcinoma: remove the mass with the involved bowel and mesentery now, to reduce the tumour burden, relieve his symptoms and prepare him for chemotherapy once he recovers

feedback.zh-CN: 冰冻切片是初步判断，可能被最终病理推翻；在肠系膜根部切除肿块会危及肠系膜上动、静脉和大段小肠，而广泛的粟粒结节说明切除无法清除病灶（PSOGI/EURACAN 2021）。这样不可逆的大手术不能凭冰冻结论决定，原报告的团队也只取了组织。
feedback.en: A frozen section is provisional and may be overturned by the final report; resecting at the mesenteric root puts the superior mesenteric artery and vein and much of the small bowel at risk, and widespread miliary nodules mean resection cannot clear the disease (PSOGI/EURACAN 2021). An irreversible operation of this size is never decided on a frozen section — the report's team took tissue only.

text.zh-CN: 冰冻已经给出诊断：取一小块组织后尽快关腹，术后做胃镜、查CA19-9和PET-CT寻找原发灶，找到原发灶后再定化疗方案
text.en: The frozen section has made the diagnosis: take one small piece and close promptly, then look for the primary with gastroscopy, CA19-9 and PET-CT and plan chemotherapy once it is found

feedback.zh-CN: 冰冻切片不是最终诊断，一小块组织可能不够做免疫组化；石蜡结果一旦与冰冻不符，就得再取组织，对81岁的老人意味着再做一次手术。鉴别间皮瘤和腺癌需要足量组织上的成套免疫组化（IMIG 2023年更新的指南），是否寻找原发灶要等石蜡病理出来再定。
feedback.en: A frozen section is not the final diagnosis, and one small piece may not be enough for immunostaining; if the paraffin report disagrees, more tissue means a second operation for an 81-year-old. Telling mesothelioma from adenocarcinoma needs a full immunohistochemical panel on adequate tissue (IMIG 2023 update), and any search for a primary waits for the paraffin report.

text.zh-CN: 高龄患者应尽量缩短手术：只留腹腔冲洗液做细胞学，不再取组织，尽快关腹，等细胞学结果出来以后再决定下一步怎么办
text.en: Keep an 81-year-old's operation as short as possible: send peritoneal washings for cytology, take no tissue and close quickly, then decide the next step once the cytology is back

feedback.zh-CN: 腹腔冲洗液细胞学常常分不清反应性间皮细胞、间皮瘤和腺癌，也不够做成套免疫组化；不取组织等于白做一次手术（PSOGI/EURACAN 2021要求以组织而不是积液细胞学诊断腹膜间皮瘤）。腹腔已经打开时，多取几块活检只多花几分钟。
feedback.en: Washings cytology often cannot separate reactive mesothelial cells, mesothelioma and adenocarcinoma, and gives too little material for a full panel; taking no tissue wastes the operation (PSOGI/EURACAN 2021 requires tissue, not effusion cytology, to diagnose peritoneal mesothelioma). With the abdomen already open, several biopsies add only minutes.

prompt.zh-CN: 术后病理：最终组织学结合免疫组化诊断为恶性间皮瘤，calretinin阳性、CK18阳性、vimentin阳性、CEA阴性；术中冰冻曾考虑转移性腺癌。你怎样看这两个结论？下一步怎么做？
prompt.en: Final pathology: histology with immunostaining reports malignant mesothelioma — calretinin positive, CK18 positive, vimentin positive, CEA negative; the frozen section had suggested metastatic adenocarcinoma. How do you weigh the two, and what do you do next?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅术后病理报告，并作答决策3。
need.en: First read the final pathology report, and answer decision 3.

text.zh-CN: 以石蜡病理为准，支持间皮瘤；补做D2-40或CK5/6等间皮标志物和claudin-4或MOC-31等癌标志物，专家复核，问石棉接触史
text.en: Trust the paraffin report, which supports mesothelioma, but add a second mesothelial marker (D2-40 or CK5/6) and carcinoma markers (claudin-4 or MOC-31), get expert review and ask about asbestos

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。最终诊断以石蜡切片和免疫组化为准，冰冻只是初步意见。国际间皮瘤兴趣小组（IMIG）2023年更新的病理诊断指南建议用两个间皮标志物和两个癌标志物组成免疫组化组合；本例只有calretinin一个特异的间皮标志物和CEA一个癌标志物，CK18和vimentin都不特异，应当补齐，必要时用BAP1或MTAP免疫组化（或CDKN2A荧光原位杂交）确认恶性。PSOGI/EURACAN 2021还要求报告写明组织学亚型和Ki-67指数，并由熟悉腹膜肿瘤的病理医生复核。间皮瘤与石棉接触有关，职业史关系到病因判断和职业病认定。
feedback.en: Right. The final diagnosis rests on paraffin histology with immunostaining; the frozen section is a provisional opinion. The International Mesothelioma Interest Group's 2023 update advises an immunopanel of two mesothelial and two carcinoma markers; here calretinin is the only specific mesothelial marker and CEA the only carcinoma marker, while CK18 and vimentin are non-specific, so complete the panel, with BAP1 or MTAP immunostaining (or CDKN2A FISH) where malignancy needs confirming. PSOGI/EURACAN 2021 also asks for the histological subtype and the Ki-67 index in the report and for review by a pathologist expert in peritoneal disease. Mesothelioma is linked to asbestos, and his work history matters for the cause and for recognition as an occupational disease.

text.zh-CN: 以冰冻结论为准：冰冻是在新鲜组织上看的，胃肠道来源的腺癌CEA也可以阴性，所以继续按转移性腺癌处理，安排胃镜和PET-CT寻找原发灶
text.en: Trust the frozen section: it was read on fresh tissue, and CEA can be negative in gastrointestinal adenocarcinoma, so keep treating this as metastatic adenocarcinoma and look for the primary with gastroscopy and PET-CT

feedback.zh-CN: 冰冻组织形态失真，只能给出初步判断，最终病理可以推翻它；石蜡切片加calretinin阳性、CEA阴性支持间皮瘤而不是腺癌（IMIG 2023年更新）。CEA阴性本身不能排除腺癌，正因如此才要补做更多癌标志物，而不是退回冰冻结论。
feedback.en: Frozen tissue loses detail and gives a provisional reading that the final report can overturn; paraffin histology with calretinin positive and CEA negative supports mesothelioma over adenocarcinoma (IMIG 2023 update). A negative CEA alone does not exclude adenocarcinoma — which is why more carcinoma markers are needed, not a return to the frozen-section reading.

text.zh-CN: calretinin阳性加CEA阴性已经足以确诊恶性间皮瘤：不必再加做染色，以免延误治疗，尽快按恶性间皮瘤做分期检查，并和他讨论治疗方案
text.en: Calretinin positive with CEA negative is enough to settle mesothelioma: further stains would only delay his treatment, so stage it as mesothelioma and discuss the options with him straight away

feedback.zh-CN: calretinin阳性、CEA阴性确实支持间皮瘤，但IMIG 2023年更新的指南建议用两个间皮标志物加两个癌标志物，因为单个标志物在部分腺癌和其他肿瘤中也会阳性。必要时还要用BAP1或MTAP免疫组化确认恶性，并请有经验的病理医生复核，治疗才有可靠依据。
feedback.en: Calretinin positive and CEA negative do favour mesothelioma, but the IMIG 2023 update advises two mesothelial and two carcinoma markers, because a single marker can be positive in some adenocarcinomas and other tumours. BAP1 or MTAP immunostaining where malignancy is in question, and review by an experienced pathologist, give treatment a sound basis.

text.zh-CN: CK18和vimentin同时阳性，提示肉瘤样癌或肉瘤，不支持间皮瘤：转骨与软组织肉瘤专科，按肉瘤做分期和治疗，不必再考虑间皮瘤
text.en: CK18 and vimentin together point to a sarcomatoid carcinoma or a sarcoma rather than mesothelioma: refer him to the sarcoma service and stage and treat it as a sarcoma

feedback.zh-CN: 间皮瘤本身就常同时表达角蛋白和vimentin，这两项同时阳性分不出间皮瘤和肉瘤（IMIG 2023年更新）；calretinin阳性支持间皮来源。组织学亚型（上皮样、双相或肉瘤样）要由病理报告说明，本病例没有记录。
feedback.en: Mesothelioma itself commonly co-expresses keratin and vimentin, so the pair cannot separate it from a sarcoma (IMIG 2023 update), and calretinin positivity supports a mesothelial origin. The histological subtype — epithelioid, biphasic or sarcomatoid — has to come from the pathology report, and this case does not record it.

prompt.zh-CN: 后来白细胞升到113.7×10⁹/L，以中性粒细胞为主，抗菌治疗下仍在上升。两次血培养阴性；骨髓粒系增生活跃，未见明显形态异常。最可能的解释是什么？下一步怎么做？
prompt.en: His white count has since reached 113.7 × 10⁹/L, mainly neutrophils, still rising on antibacterial treatment. Two blood cultures were negative, and the marrow showed active granulopoiesis without obvious atypia. What is the most likely explanation, and what do you do next?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅最新的血常规、血培养和骨髓结果，并作答决策4。
need.en: First read the latest blood count, the blood cultures and the marrow, and answer decision 4.

text.zh-CN: 多半是肿瘤相关的类白血病反应，但要靠排除：复核血涂片，查BCR::ABL1和CSF3R，再找未引流的感染灶，停用没有目标的抗菌药，并视为病情凶险的信号
text.en: Probably a tumour-related leukaemoid reaction, but only by exclusion: review the film, test BCR::ABL1 and CSF3R, look again for an undrained source, stop untargeted antibiotics, and read it as a grave sign

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。白细胞超过50×10⁹/L、以成熟中性粒细胞为主而不是白血病，称为类白血病反应；实体瘤（包括间皮瘤）可分泌G-CSF或IL-6引起，但这是排除性诊断。WHO造血与淋巴组织肿瘤分类第5版（2022）要求先排除BCR::ABL1阳性的慢性髓性白血病，并查CSF3R排除慢性中性粒细胞白血病；抗菌治疗无效、培养阴性时，要重新寻找感染灶，停用没有目标的抗菌药（IDSA/SHEA 2016抗菌药物管理指南）。肿瘤相关的极度白细胞增多往往提示预后差，应当纳入和他的谈话。
feedback.en: Right. A count above 50 × 10⁹/L of mainly mature neutrophils that is not leukaemia is a leukaemoid reaction; solid tumours, mesothelioma among them, can cause one by secreting G-CSF or IL-6, but it is a diagnosis of exclusion. The WHO classification, 5th edition (2022), asks for BCR::ABL1-positive chronic myeloid leukaemia to be excluded and CSF3R to be tested for chronic neutrophilic leukaemia; with antibiotics failing and cultures negative, look again for a source and stop antibiotics with no target (IDSA/SHEA 2016 stewardship guideline). Tumour-related extreme leucocytosis usually signals a poor prognosis, which belongs in your conversation with him.

text.zh-CN: 白细胞超过100×10⁹/L、骨髓粒系增生活跃，这是慢性髓性白血病：马上用羟基脲把白细胞降下来，以防白细胞淤滞，等BCR::ABL1结果出来后加用伊马替尼
text.en: A count over 100 × 10⁹/L with active granulopoiesis means chronic myeloid leukaemia: start hydroxycarbamide now to bring it down before leukostasis sets in, and add imatinib once the BCR::ABL1 result is back

feedback.zh-CN: 骨髓粒系增生活跃、未见明显形态异常，白细胞以成熟中性粒细胞为主，更像反应性增多；诊断慢性髓性白血病必须证实BCR::ABL1（WHO第5版，2022），不能凭计数。白细胞淤滞来自原始细胞而不是成熟中性粒细胞，羟基脲只是在降一个数字，还会让一位可能有感染的高龄患者骨髓抑制。
feedback.en: Active granulopoiesis without obvious atypia and a count of mature neutrophils look reactive; chronic myeloid leukaemia needs BCR::ABL1 to be shown (WHO 5th edition, 2022), not a high count. Leukostasis comes from blasts, not mature neutrophils, so hydroxycarbamide treats a number, not a disease, and risks marrow suppression in an older man who may be infected.

text.zh-CN: 两次血培养阴性不能排除感染，白细胞越来越高说明感染没控制住：换用碳青霉烯类，加用抗真菌药，一直用到白细胞降下来为止
text.en: Two negative cultures do not exclude infection, and a climbing count means it is out of control: switch to a carbapenem, add an antifungal, and keep both going until the white count comes down

feedback.zh-CN: 两次培养阴性确实不能完全排除感染（他入院前已经用过抗菌药），但抗菌治疗下白细胞仍在上升时，答案不是盲目升级：应重新寻找未引流的感染灶，并考虑非感染原因。没有目标地加用碳青霉烯类和抗真菌药，只会增加毒性、艰难梭菌感染和耐药（IDSA/SHEA 2016抗菌药物管理指南）。
feedback.en: Two negative cultures do not fully exclude infection — he had antimicrobials before admission — but when the count keeps rising on antibiotics the answer is not blind escalation: look again for an undrained source and consider non-infective causes. A carbapenem and an antifungal with no target add toxicity, C. difficile infection and resistance (IDSA/SHEA 2016 stewardship guideline).

text.zh-CN: 骨髓只见粒系增生，已经证明是肿瘤在分泌G-CSF：不需要再做其他检查，针对肿瘤治疗就能把白细胞降下来，抗菌药可以照常用下去
text.en: A marrow showing only granulocytic hyperplasia proves the tumour is secreting G-CSF: no further tests are needed, treating the tumour will bring the count down, and the antibiotics can simply continue

feedback.zh-CN: 骨髓粒系增生只说明是反应性改变，并不能证明是哪种细胞因子在起作用；本病例没有检测G-CSF或IL-6，也没有做克隆性检查。在排除慢性髓性白血病、慢性中性粒细胞白血病和隐匿感染之前（WHO第5版，2022），不能下“肿瘤分泌G-CSF”的结论；没有目标的抗菌药也应停用。
feedback.en: Granulocytic hyperplasia in the marrow shows a reactive picture; it does not prove which cytokine drives it, and this case records no G-CSF or IL-6 level and no clonality testing. Tumour G-CSF secretion cannot be concluded before chronic myeloid leukaemia, chronic neutrophilic leukaemia and an occult infection have been excluded (WHO 5th edition, 2022), and antibiotics with no target should stop.

text.zh-CN: 问清起病时间、疼痛部位和性质、病情变化、体温和寒战、尿路及排便症状、外院诊治、用过的抗菌药、平时用药和过敏史
text.en: Elicited the onset, the site and character of the pain, the course, the temperature and chills, the urinary and bowel symptoms, the care elsewhere, the antimicrobials given, regular medicines and allergies

text.zh-CN: 视诊腹部，触诊压痛、反跳痛、肌紧张和包块，并叩诊肾区
text.en: Inspected the abdomen, palpated for tenderness, rebound, guarding and a mass, and percussed the renal angles

text.zh-CN: 入院时看血常规并送尿常规和尿培养；检查阶段调阅影像、结肠镜、小肠造影、血培养和骨髓结果
text.en: Read the admission count and sent urinalysis and urine culture; in the work-up, read the imaging, colonoscopy, small-bowel study, blood cultures and marrow

text.zh-CN: 入院阶段先送血培养，再开始覆盖肠道革兰阴性菌和厌氧菌的静脉抗菌药，并申请腹盆腔影像检查
text.en: In the admission phase, sent blood cultures, then started IV antibiotics covering enteric Gram-negative and anaerobic bacteria, and requested abdominal and pelvic imaging

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即按可能的复杂性腹腔感染制定入院方案，并安排全套生命体征和NEWS2评分
text.en: Chose the admission plan for a possible complicated abdominal infection at the first attempt, and set up full observations with a NEWS2 score

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择粗针活检取得组织，手术中也只取足量组织、不做切除；并在检查阶段申请了粗针活检
text.en: Chose a core biopsy to obtain tissue and, in theatre, generous biopsies without resection, each at the first attempt, and requested the core biopsy during the work-up

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即以最终病理为准并指出免疫组化需要补齐，申请补充染色，并询问石棉接触史
text.en: Weighed the final report over the frozen section and saw that the panel was incomplete at the first attempt, ordered the further stains and asked about asbestos

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把极度的白细胞增多作为排除性诊断处理，送检BCR::ABL1和CSF3R，并在术后复评、停用没有目标的抗菌药
text.en: Handled the extreme white count as a diagnosis of exclusion at the first attempt, sent BCR::ABL1 and CSF3R, and reviewed the antibiotics after the operation

text.zh-CN: 提交多学科讨论，安排和他谈诊断与下一步，并请姑息治疗团队参与
text.en: Referred him to the MDT, arranged a conversation with him about the diagnosis and plan, and involved the palliative care team

text.zh-CN: 没有用地塞米松退热，也没有凭冰冻结论切除肿块及受累肠管
text.en: Gave no dexamethasone to bring down his fever, and did not resect the mass and involved bowel on the strength of a frozen section

text.zh-CN: 没有用羟基脲降白细胞，没有无目标地升级为碳青霉烯类加抗真菌药，也没有让他口服抗菌药出院
text.en: Did not lower the count with hydroxycarbamide, escalate to a carbapenem with an antifungal without a target, or send him home on oral antibiotics

text.zh-CN: 用SPIKES告诉他诊断和其中的不确定性，了解他最看重什么，并和他共同商定下一步
text.en: Told him the diagnosis and its uncertainty with SPIKES, learnt what matters most to him and agreed the next steps with him

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（SPIKES，结合Calgary–Cambridge的结构）：在术后病理出来后，选安静的地方、留足时间，问他想让谁在场；先问他已经知道什么、想知道多少——他说过“年纪大了，直说就行”，但仍要一步一步来。用通俗的话说明：手术看到肚子里长了东西，原来以为是别处转来的癌，最后的病理认为是腹膜上长出来的一种恶性肿瘤（间皮瘤），病理科还要加做几项染色把诊断做实；说明白细胞很高可能和这个肿瘤有关，同时还在排除感染和血液病。坦诚说明这次手术没有切除肿块、以后能做的治疗有限，按他的身体情况，大手术多半不合适，可以讨论药物治疗，也可以以控制发热、腹痛和腹胀为主；问清他最看重什么，把姑息治疗作为同样正当的选择，并说明无论怎么选都会继续照顾他。顺带、不带指责地问他做过什么工作、有没有接触过石棉，并说明这和病因、职业病认定有关。回应情绪，留出提问时间，用回授法确认理解，约好下次再谈并记录。不要给出本病例没有的生存期数字，不要把发热简单说成“肿瘤热”而停止排查，不要替他作决定，也不要只和家属谈而绕开他本人。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (SPIKES within a Calgary–Cambridge structure): once the final pathology is back, a quiet place and enough time, asking whom he wants present; first asks what he already knows and how much he wants to know — he has said “just tell me straight”, but it still goes step by step. Explains in plain words that the operation found a growth inside his abdomen, first thought to be a cancer spread from elsewhere, which the final pathology reads as a cancer of the lining of the abdomen (mesothelioma), with a few more stains under way to make the diagnosis firm; that the very high white count may come from the tumour while infection and a blood disorder are still being ruled out. Is honest that the mass was not removed at the operation and that treatment options are limited — at his age and in his condition a major operation is unlikely to suit him — and sets out drug treatment and care focused on fever, pain and swelling as real choices; asks what matters most to him, offers palliative care as an equally valid path, and says he will be looked after whatever he chooses. Asks, without blame, what work he did and whether he was ever around asbestos, explaining why it matters for the cause and for occupational-disease recognition. Responds to emotion, leaves time for questions, checks understanding by teach-back, agrees when to talk again and documents it. Does not quote survival figures the case does not record, does not dismiss the fever as “tumour fever” and stop looking, does not decide for him, and does not talk only to relatives around him.

name.zh-CN: 江医生（消化内科上级医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 消化内科上级医师，用苏格拉底式提问带教，按PEARLS复盘，只围绕学员已经得到的资料提问，例如：“治疗以后哪些症状变了、哪些没变？这说明问题更可能在哪里？”“哪些体征能区分腹膜刺激和肾脏的问题？做影像之前，哪些做法有风险？”“肠道检查能告诉你病变在肠内还是肠外吗？什么样的标本能让病理医生下诊断？”“你有多信任术中冰冻？一组免疫组化要怎样才算完整？”“如果不是感染，还有什么能让白细胞升得很高？要怎么证明？”“你会怎样把诊断告诉一位81岁的老人？”说明这是2014年发表的临床病例讨论：当年的检查和免疫组化组合与现在不同，它的病程不能用来评价今天的治疗。不提前透露任何检查结果、诊断、决策答案或结局，陷阱和答案留到复盘时再讲。他的生命体征和体温数值、尿检、C反应蛋白、所用抗菌药、既往史、平时用药、过敏、职业和石棉接触、报告以外的病理细节、已记录血常规以外的血液检查、确诊后的治疗和离院后的结局都没有记录，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: Gastroenterology attending who teaches by Socratic questions and debriefs with PEARLS, asking only about what the learner already has, e.g. “Which symptoms changed with the treatment and which did not — and what does that say about where the problem lies?”, “Which signs separate peritoneal irritation from a kidney problem, and which steps are risky before imaging?”, “Can the bowel studies tell you whether a lesion is inside or outside the bowel, and what sample lets a pathologist name it?”, “How far do you trust a frozen section, and what makes an immunohistochemical panel complete?”, “If infection is not the answer, what else can drive a white count very high, and how would you prove it?”, “How will you tell an 81-year-old man his diagnosis?”. Explains that this is a clinicopathological discussion published in 2014: its tests and immunostaining differ from today's and its course is no measure of treatment now. Never reveals a result, the diagnosis, a decision's answer or the outcome early, and keeps the traps and answers for the debrief; his vital signs and temperature readings, urine tests, CRP, the antibiotics used, past history, regular medicines, allergies, occupation and asbestos exposure, pathology details beyond the report, blood tests beyond the recorded counts, treatment after the diagnosis and his outcome after leaving are not recorded — never supply them.

knowledge.zh-CN: 病房护士。交班（ISBAR）：81岁男性，左下腹痛伴发热入院；入院前经抗感染治疗，尿路症状减轻，但腹痛和发热持续；白细胞升高。可以协助建立静脉通路和采血、留血培养和尿标本、测生命体征并做NEWS2评分、按医嘱给药、联系CT室、内镜室和放射科转运，以及术前准备。复述医嘱，只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到他的生命体征、体温数值、体重、用药或过敏史时，直接说没有记录可报，从不报数字。
knowledge.en: Ward nurse. Handover (ISBAR): 81-year-old man admitted with left lower abdominal pain and fever; before admission his urinary symptoms eased with antimicrobial treatment, but the pain and fever have continued; his white count is raised. Can help with IV access and bloods, blood cultures and urine samples, observations with a NEWS2 score, giving prescribed drugs, arranging transfer to CT, endoscopy and radiology, and preparing him for theatre. Reads orders back, reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and, asked for his vital signs, temperature readings, weight, medicines or allergies, says plainly there is nothing recorded to report — never gives a number.

knowledge.zh-CN: 病理科医生，只解读学员已经看过的病理结果。可以讲：冰冻切片的局限（组织冻存后形态失真，间皮瘤等腹膜原发肿瘤和转移性腺癌在冰冻上容易混淆）；国际间皮瘤兴趣小组2023年更新的病理诊断指南——一般用两个间皮标志物（calretinin、D2-40、CK5/6效果最好，另有WT1）和两个癌标志物（如claudin-4、MOC-31、Ber-EP4、CEA），按鉴别诊断选择，必要时用BAP1或MTAP免疫组化、CDKN2A荧光原位杂交区分恶性与反应性间皮增生；CK18和vimentin不特异；组织学亚型影响预后，PSOGI/EURACAN 2021要求报告写明亚型和Ki-67指数，并由熟悉腹膜肿瘤的病理医生复核；较早的文献曾用nm23等标志物推断原发或转移，现在的诊断标准不依靠它。不提前给出决策答案，不补充本病例没有记录的染色、亚型或增殖指数。
knowledge.en: Pathologist who interprets only pathology the learner has already read. Can explain the limits of frozen sections (frozen tissue loses detail; mesothelioma and other primary peritoneal tumours are easily mistaken for metastatic adenocarcinoma); the International Mesothelioma Interest Group's 2023 update — an immunopanel of two mesothelial markers (calretinin, D2-40 and CK5/6 perform best; WT1) and two carcinoma markers (such as claudin-4, MOC-31, Ber-EP4, CEA) chosen for the differential, with BAP1 or MTAP immunostaining or CDKN2A FISH to separate malignant from reactive mesothelial proliferation; that CK18 and vimentin are non-specific; that the histological subtype matters for prognosis, and PSOGI/EURACAN 2021 asks the report to give it with the Ki-67 index and requires review by a pathologist expert in peritoneal disease; and that markers such as nm23, used in older papers to argue primary versus metastatic origin, play no part in today's criteria. Never gives a decision's answer early, and adds no stain, subtype or proliferation index the case does not record.

knowledge.zh-CN: 血液科医生，只解读学员已经看过的血常规、血培养和骨髓结果。可以讲：类白血病反应通常指白细胞超过50×10⁹/L、并非白血病所致的白细胞增多，以成熟中性粒细胞为主；实体瘤可分泌G-CSF或IL-6引起，是排除性诊断；按WHO造血与淋巴组织肿瘤分类第5版（2022），要用BCR::ABL1排除慢性髓性白血病、查CSF3R排除慢性中性粒细胞白血病，并排除感染、激素和G-CSF等药物因素；白细胞淤滞来自原始细胞，成熟中性粒细胞增多不需要羟基脲或白细胞单采；中性粒细胞碱性磷酸酶积分是旧的鉴别方法。不提前给出决策答案或结局，不补充没有记录的结果（分类计数、血红蛋白、血小板、细胞因子、分子检测）。
knowledge.en: Haematologist who interprets only the counts, cultures and marrow the learner has already read. Can explain that a leukaemoid reaction usually means a white count above 50 × 10⁹/L, mostly mature neutrophils, that is not caused by leukaemia; that solid tumours can cause one by secreting G-CSF or IL-6 and that it is a diagnosis of exclusion; that under the WHO classification, 5th edition (2022), BCR::ABL1 excludes chronic myeloid leukaemia and CSF3R testing chronic neutrophilic leukaemia, alongside infection and drugs such as steroids or G-CSF; that leukostasis comes from blasts, so a mature neutrophilia needs no hydroxycarbamide or leukapheresis; and that the neutrophil alkaline phosphatase score is an older way of telling the two apart. Never gives a decision's answer or the outcome early, and adds no result the case does not record (differential, haemoglobin, platelets, cytokines, molecular tests).

knowledge.zh-CN: 普外科医生，在病房会诊，也主刀手术探查。只解读学员已经看过的影像和手术记录。可以讲：腹腔感染要尽早控制感染源——美国外科感染学会（SIS）2024年更新的指南要求低危患者12小时内完成，合并脓毒性休克的高危患者6小时内；CT能显示有没有需要引流的积液或脓肿；肠外肿块在任何切除之前要先取得组织诊断。学员看过术中所见以后，可以说明肠系膜根部受累并有广泛结节时切除清除不了病灶，还会危及肠系膜上血管；减瘤手术加腹腔热灌注化疗只适合确诊后、病变可以切净、身体能承受大手术、在腹膜肿瘤专科中心治疗的患者（PSOGI/EURACAN 2021）。手术中他打电话报告术中所见和冰冻结果，问学员下一步怎么办，但不替学员回答。不提前给出决策答案，不说探查是腹腔镜还是开腹，不补充本病例没有记录的手术细节、结节部位或腹水情况。
knowledge.en: General surgeon who sees him on the ward and leads the exploration. Interprets only the imaging and the operative record the learner has already read. Can explain that an abdominal source of infection needs early control — the Surgical Infection Society's 2024 update asks for it within 12 hours in lower-risk patients and within 6 hours in higher-risk patients with septic shock; that CT shows whether there is a collection to drain; and that a mass outside the bowel needs a tissue diagnosis before any resection. Once the learner has read the operative findings, can explain that disease at the mesenteric root with widespread nodules cannot be cleared by resection, which would endanger the superior mesenteric vessels, and that cytoreductive surgery with HIPEC is only for patients with a confirmed diagnosis, resectable disease and the fitness for a major operation, treated at a specialist peritoneal centre (PSOGI/EURACAN 2021). From theatre he phones through the findings and the frozen section and asks the learner what to do next, without answering for them. Never gives a decision's answer early, never says whether the exploration was laparoscopic or open, and adds no operative detail, nodule site or fluid finding the case does not record.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：发热、肠外肿块与极度中性粒细胞增多——腹膜恶性间皮瘤
title.en: Debrief: fever, a mass outside the bowel and extreme neutrophilia — malignant peritoneal mesothelioma

conclusion.zh-CN: 81岁男性，左下腹隐痛伴发热；入院前治疗后尿路症状好转，腹痛发热不退。查体腹部膨隆，左下腹压痛、反跳痛，无肌紧张，未触及明确包块，左肾区叩痛。白细胞由28.8升至33.3×10⁹/L，以成熟中性粒细胞为主。影像见左下腹7.1 cm×6.3 cm×9.9 cm囊实性、有血流的肿块，周围脂肪模糊，腹盆腔积液；结肠镜无明显异常，小肠受外压而无外漏。两次血培养阴性，骨髓粒系增生活跃、无明显形态异常。探查见肠系膜根部肿块和广泛粟粒结节，冰冻考虑转移性腺癌，最终病理为恶性间皮瘤（calretinin、CK18、vimentin阳性，CEA阴性）；只取了组织。白细胞后来升至113.7×10⁹/L，以中性粒细胞为主，抗菌无效，原团队考虑类白血病反应；患者离院，结局不详。今天的做法：先按腹腔感染留培养、静脉抗菌并做CT，用粗针活检取组织，以石蜡病理为准并按IMIG补齐染色，类白血病反应须排除慢性髓性白血病、慢性中性粒细胞白血病和感染后才能认定。
conclusion.en: An 81-year-old man had dull left lower abdominal pain and fever that outlasted treatment, though his urinary symptoms eased. His abdomen was distended, with left lower quadrant tenderness and rebound but no guarding; no definite mass was felt, and the left renal angle was tender to percussion. White cells rose from 28.8 to 33.3 × 10⁹/L (mature neutrophils). Imaging: a 7.1 × 6.3 × 9.9 cm cystic-solid mass in the left lower abdomen, vascular on ultrasound, with blurred surrounding fat and abdominopelvic fluid; colonoscopy showed no obvious abnormality; the small bowel was compressed from outside without leak. Two blood cultures were negative; the marrow showed active granulopoiesis without obvious atypia. Exploration: a mesenteric-root mass with widespread miliary nodules; frozen section suggested metastatic adenocarcinoma, final histology malignant mesothelioma (calretinin, CK18, vimentin positive; CEA negative); only tissue was taken. The count later reached 113.7 × 10⁹/L, mainly neutrophils, despite antibiotics; a leukaemoid reaction was considered. He left hospital; outcome unknown. Today: treat and image first, a core biopsy, a full IMIG panel, and a leukaemoid reaction proved by exclusion.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 尿路症状治疗后减轻了，腹痛和发热却没好，加上左下腹反跳痛和不断升高的中性粒细胞，说明问题不在泌尿道：必须先排除需要处理的腹腔感染源。
keyReasoning.en: Urinary symptoms that eased while the pain and fever did not, with left lower quadrant rebound and a rising neutrophil count, move the problem out of the urinary tract: an abdominal source that needs control has to be excluded first.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 一个近10 cm、却在膨隆的腹部摸不到的肿块，结肠镜无明显异常、小肠只受外压而无外漏，位置就在肠外；鉴别诊断随之从结肠病变转向系膜和腹膜的肿瘤。
keyReasoning.en: A mass of almost 10 cm that could not be felt in a distended abdomen, with a colonoscopy showing no obvious abnormality and a small bowel compressed from outside without leak, lies outside the bowel — and the differential shifts from colonic disease to tumours of the mesentery and peritoneum.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 肠系膜根部受累加广泛粟粒结节，意味着切除清除不了病灶，而且风险很大；冰冻切片只是初步判断，不能用来决定不可逆的手术。
keyReasoning.en: Involvement of the mesenteric root with widespread miliary nodules means resection could not clear the disease and would carry great risk, and a frozen section is too provisional to decide an irreversible operation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: calretinin阳性、CEA阴性让结论从转移性腺癌转向间皮瘤，但一个特异的间皮标志物和一个癌标志物还不是完整的诊断组合。
keyReasoning.en: Calretinin positive with CEA negative turns the reading from metastatic adenocarcinoma towards mesothelioma, but one specific mesothelial marker and one carcinoma marker are not yet a full diagnostic panel.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 抗菌治疗下白细胞仍升到113.7×10⁹/L，培养阴性，骨髓无明显形态异常，这既不像未控制的感染，也不像白血病，而指向肿瘤驱动的反应——但这仍需要逐一排除来证明。
keyReasoning.en: A count that climbed to 113.7 × 10⁹/L on antibiotics, with negative cultures and a marrow without obvious atypia, fits neither uncontrolled infection nor leukaemia and points to a tumour-driven reaction — which still has to be proved by exclusion.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是2014年发表的单例临床病例讨论，不能用来比较治疗方法，也不能据此判断腹膜间皮瘤的预后。病例事实沿用1.0.0版的提取内容，尚未对照原文全文核对；本病例没有记录生命体征、多数化验、所用抗菌药、确诊后的治疗和远期结局，也不模拟任何生理变化。决策、处置选项、评分和教学要点是依据现行指南的教学设计，不改变已发表的病程。
boundaries.en: This is a single clinicopathological case discussion published in 2014: it cannot compare treatments or set a prognosis for peritoneal mesothelioma. The case facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0 and have not yet been checked against the full article; the case records no vital signs, most blood tests, the antibiotics used, treatment after the diagnosis or the long-term outcome, and no physiology is simulated. The decisions, management options, scoring and teaching points are teaching design based on current guidance and do not change the published course.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 入院处置：高龄、发热、左下腹局限性腹膜刺激征、白细胞28.8×10⁹/L，入院前治疗后不退——先按复杂性腹腔感染处理：用NEWS2等评分而不是单用qSOFA筛查脓毒症（SSC 2026），先留血、尿培养，再静脉覆盖肠道革兰阴性菌和厌氧菌，并尽早控制感染源（SIS 2024：12小时内，合并脓毒性休克时6小时内）；影像首选增强CT（IDSA 2024），结肠镜等急性期过后再做（WSES 2020）。原报告的团队用了抗菌药，记录为无效；两次血培养阴性，但入院前已用过抗菌药，阴性结果不能完全排除感染。
teachingPoints.en: Admission: an older man with fever, localised left lower quadrant peritonism and white cells of 28.8 × 10⁹/L that persist after treatment elsewhere is managed first as a complicated intra-abdominal infection — screen with NEWS2 or similar rather than qSOFA alone (SSC 2026), take blood and urine cultures before IV cover of enteric Gram-negative and anaerobic bacteria, and control the source early (SIS 2024: within 12 hours, or 6 with septic shock), with contrast CT as the first imaging (IDSA 2024) and colonoscopy only once the acute episode has settled (WSES 2020). The report's team gave antibiotics, recorded as ineffective; the two blood cultures were negative, but he had had antimicrobials before admission, so they do not fully exclude infection.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 定位与取材：结肠镜无明显异常、小肠造影见外压而无外漏，肿块在肠外。系膜或腹膜肿块的鉴别包括淋巴瘤、胃肠间质瘤、肉瘤、腹膜原发肿瘤和转移瘤，治疗取决于组织学，所以首选影像引导下粗针活检（必要时腹腔镜），而不是只做细胞学，也不是先手术切除（PSOGI/EURACAN 2021要求以粗针穿刺活检或探查性腹腔镜取得的组织诊断，而不是积液细胞学或细针穿刺材料）。原报告的团队选择了手术探查。
teachingPoints.en: Localisation and tissue: a colonoscopy without obvious abnormality and extrinsic compression without leak place the mass outside the bowel. A mesenteric or peritoneal mass may be lymphoma, GIST, sarcoma, a primary peritoneal tumour or a metastasis, and treatment depends on histology, so an image-guided core biopsy (or laparoscopy) comes first — not cytology alone and not a resection (PSOGI/EURACAN 2021 requires tissue from a core needle biopsy or exploratory laparoscopy, not effusion cytology or fine-needle material). The report's team chose a surgical exploration.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 冰冻与石蜡：本例冰冻考虑转移性腺癌，最终病理为恶性间皮瘤——间皮瘤与腺癌在冰冻上容易混淆。肠系膜根部受累、广泛粟粒结节时，只取足量组织、不切除是对的（原报告也只取了组织）；减瘤手术加腹腔热灌注化疗只适合确诊后、经过筛选、在有经验中心治疗的患者（PSOGI/EURACAN 2021）。
teachingPoints.en: Frozen versus paraffin: here the frozen section suggested metastatic adenocarcinoma and the final histology gave malignant mesothelioma — the two are easily confused on frozen tissue. With the mesenteric root involved and widespread miliary nodules, taking generous tissue without resection was right (the report's team took tissue only); cytoreductive surgery with HIPEC is for selected patients with a confirmed diagnosis at experienced centres (PSOGI/EURACAN 2021).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 免疫组化标准：国际间皮瘤兴趣小组2023年更新的指南建议用两个间皮标志物和两个癌标志物，怀疑恶性时加BAP1或MTAP免疫组化（或CDKN2A荧光原位杂交）；本例只有calretinin（+）和CEA（−）两项特异指标，CK18和vimentin都不特异，按今天的标准应补做D2-40或CK5/6，以及claudin-4、MOC-31或Ber-EP4。同时采集职业性石棉接触史：“石棉所致肺癌、间皮瘤”列入我国《职业病分类和目录》（2024年版，2025年8月起施行），属于法定职业病。
teachingPoints.en: Immunostaining standard: the International Mesothelioma Interest Group's 2023 update advises two mesothelial and two carcinoma markers, with BAP1 or MTAP immunostaining (or CDKN2A FISH) where malignancy is in doubt; here only calretinin (positive) and CEA (negative) are specific, CK18 and vimentin are not, so today the panel would add D2-40 or CK5/6 and claudin-4, MOC-31 or Ber-EP4. Take an occupational asbestos history too: asbestos-related mesothelioma is a statutory occupational disease in China (Classification and Catalogue of Occupational Diseases, 2024 edition, in force since August 2025).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 极度中性粒细胞增多：白细胞28.8→33.3→113.7×10⁹/L，以成熟中性粒细胞为主，骨髓粒系增生活跃而无明显异常，培养阴性，抗菌无效——符合肿瘤相关的类白血病反应（常见定义为白细胞＞50×10⁹/L、非白血病所致；实体瘤可分泌G-CSF或IL-6）。它是排除性诊断：按WHO第5版（2022）查BCR::ABL1和CSF3R，排除隐匿感染和药物；不用羟基脲或白细胞单采，不盲目升级抗菌药（IDSA/SHEA 2016）。原团队只是“考虑”类白血病反应，没有记录细胞因子或克隆性检查。
teachingPoints.en: Extreme neutrophilia: white cells of 28.8 → 33.3 → 113.7 × 10⁹/L, mainly mature neutrophils, an active marrow without obvious atypia, negative cultures and failed antibiotics fit a tumour-related leukaemoid reaction (commonly defined as a count above 50 × 10⁹/L not caused by leukaemia; solid tumours can secrete G-CSF or IL-6). It is a diagnosis of exclusion: BCR::ABL1 and CSF3R testing under the WHO 5th edition (2022), and occult infection and drugs ruled out; no hydroxycarbamide or leukapheresis, and no blind antibiotic escalation (IDSA/SHEA 2016). The report's team only “considered” a leukaemoid reaction; no cytokine or clonality testing is recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 和患者沟通：对一位81岁、肿块没有切除、白细胞极高的老人，用SPIKES说明诊断和不确定性，问清他最看重什么，把全身治疗和以姑息治疗为主的照护作为同样正当的选择；不要给出本病例没有的生存数字。原报告只记录他随后离院、远期结局不详。
teachingPoints.en: Talking with him: for an 81-year-old whose mass was not removed and whose count is extreme, use SPIKES to give the diagnosis and its uncertainty, find out what matters most to him, and set systemic treatment and palliative-focused care side by side as valid choices — without survival figures the case does not record. The report records only that he then left hospital, with the long-term outcome unknown.
